sentences.en: It is dangerous for you to swim in this river.
sentences.zh: 你在这条河里游泳很危险。

sentences.en: Nuclear power plants are dangerous, not to mention nuclear weapons.
sentences.zh: 核电厂就很危险了，更不用说核武器了。

sentences.en: It is dangerous to ride a motorbike without a helmet.
sentences.zh: 不戴头盔骑摩托车很危险。
